text:
tessa: Hey all  popped into my head  sunset spritz + boardwalk stroll this Sat 6pm? Quick meetup on the plaza, then a short walk along the pier. Low-key. :sunset: :cocktail:

omar: In if there's a non-alc spritz option. Also can we keep it short? I have an evening call.

tessa: Absolutely  aiming to be done by 8. Non-alc spritzers welcome.

lucy: I can bring a pizza box (veggie) and a folding blanket.

ben: I'll bring a small portable speaker and a deck of art card games (very silly).

kai: Is this kid-friendly? Might bring my little one for the walk.

tessa: Kid-friendly; plaza has space. Bring stroller if needed.

omar: Weather check? Any rain plan?

tessa: If light rain -> covered arcade area. If heavy -> reschedule Sun 6. Final call Fri 3pm.

lucy: Quick poll  react: :pizza: for pizza-led snacks, :cocktail: for drinks focus, :game_die: for games & board focus, :baby: if bringing kids.

ben: :game_die: :cocktail:

kai: :baby: :pizza:

omar: :cocktail: (non-alc pls)

lucy: :pizza:

tessa: Looks like pizza + games + spritzers. I'll grab napkins and an insulated bag.

ben: I can fetch a folding table from events at 5:20 if we need a spot for food.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Sunset Spritz & Boardwalk Stroll" Sat 18:00  reminder at 15:00.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Sunset Spritz + Boardwalk Stroll" Sat 18:00  guests updated. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/2600000000

tessa: Can someone volunteer to pick up ice? I'll handle pizza pickup at 5:30.

omar: I'll grab ice and a box of cups.

kai: I'll bring a stroller seat and some baby snacks.

lucy: Great. See you Saturday  bring warm layers for the pier breeze. :scarf:
